title: Multi-agency resource reconciliation
description: Extract each agency's resource picture separately, merge them declaratively, and keep every double-committed or stale resource as a source-tagged exception.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-crisis-02
  title: Multi-agency resource reconciliation
  description: Extract each agency's resource picture separately, merge them declaratively, and keep every
    double-committed or stale resource as a source-tagged exception.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce one authoritative resource picture across agencies where every conflict carries its
    source and as-of time instead of being resolved silently.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Agency resource submissions
      summary: Agency resource submissions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - agency_resource_lists
              - commitments
              - mutual_aid_requests
              - as_of_times
            properties:
              agency_resource_lists: {}
              commitments: {}
              mutual_aid_requests: {}
              as_of_times: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-source1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: crisis-03
      name: Primary agency resource extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 1: primary agency resource extraction.'
      role: Logistics officer tracking what is available, committed, and en route.
      prompt: You are a Resource & Logistics Officer. You maintain one authoritative picture of resources
        — available, committed, en route, out of service — reconciled across agencies, and you flag double-committed
        resources immediately. You state resource status with its as-of time, because in a multi-agency
        response the most dangerous number is a stale one presented as current.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:cad-system
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-source2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: crisis-05
      name: Mutual aid and partner extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 2: mutual aid and partner extraction.'
      role: Analyst building a common operating picture from conflicting reports.
      prompt: You are a Situation Assessment Analyst. You build a common operating picture from field
        reports, sensors, and public information, marking each element with its source, time, and confidence,
        and you keep conflicting reports visible rather than resolving them prematurely. You distinguish
        confirmed from reported, because acting on an unconfirmed report as if it were confirmed is how
        responses are misdirected.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - source-triangulation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:cad-system
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-union
      kind: transform
      name: Merge agency resource pictures
      summary: merge the extracted resource records on resource_id, agency, and as_of_time
      config:
        operation: merge
        expression: merge the extracted resource records on resource_id, agency, and as_of_time
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: crisis-03
      name: Reconcile matched resource records
      summary: Reconcile fields that arrived from more than one source.
      role: Logistics officer tracking what is available, committed, and en route.
      prompt: You are a Resource & Logistics Officer. You maintain one authoritative picture of resources
        — available, committed, en route, out of service — reconciled across agencies, and you flag double-committed
        resources immediately. You state resource status with its as-of time, because in a multi-agency
        response the most dangerous number is a stale one presented as current.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:cad-system
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-exceptions
      kind: agent
      templateRef: crisis-02
      name: State double commitments and stale records as exceptions
      summary: Everything that could not be reconciled, stated as an exception.
      role: Analyst running scenarios that stress plans rather than confirming them.
      prompt: You are a Scenario Simulation Analyst. You build scenarios that stress the plan's assumptions
        — concurrent events, degraded communications, staff unavailability, failed mutual aid — and you
        report where the plan breaks rather than whether it passed. You state the assumption each scenario
        is designed to test, because an exercise that confirms the plan teaches nobody anything.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-register
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect the exception register
      summary: Every unreconciled field is source-tagged so an exception keeps its provenance.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-clean
      kind: condition
      name: Exception register empty?
      summary: Route on register.exceptions is empty.
      config:
        expression: register.exceptions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clean
            when: clean
          - label: Exceptions
            when: exceptions
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Incident commander accepts the common resource picture
      summary: Pause for the incident commander; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Multi-agency resource reconciliation deliverable, the evidence behind
        it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-3
      from: n-source1
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-4
      from: n-source2
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-5
      from: n-union
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-6
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-exceptions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-7
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-8
      from: n-exceptions
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-9
      from: n-register
      to: n-clean
      kind: data
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-10
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clean
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-11
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: exceptions
    - id: wf-crisis-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
